title: POST /api/integration/events
description: Integration token only. Batch of integration events for the log tab. Sent at most every 10 s (sooner from 20 events). While the hub is unreachable the integration keeps at most 500 events in memory (oldest dropped first, counted in dropped) and sends them later; nothing is written to disk. The hub stores them with its log retention and derives alarms (threshold of rejections in rest/log-settings.json alarm_threshold; the log tab, docs/log.md). Idempotent per event id.

dropped.description: Events lost since the last accepted batch (queue full).
